history.summary: A 1,001sqft 2BR at $1.24M / $1,239 PSF just 270m from the new Bayshore TEL station (D16), priced ~10% below the $1,372 median on an exceptionally reliable 5.75% CAGR (232 txns). A genuine TEL-proximity catalyst at a liquid sub-$1.3M price, with the 1996 leasehold age as the main offset.
history.rating_rationale: This pairs the batch's most reliable appreciation data (5.75%/yr over 232 transactions — very high confidence) with a real, near-term catalyst: 270m to the newly opened Bayshore TEL station in the up-and-coming Bayshore precinct. It's priced ~10% below URA median at a deeply liquid $1.24M / $1,239 PSF with a sensible 2BR size. The clear caveat is age — a 1996 99yr lease has ~69yr left — but the TEL station opening, the strong discount, and the deep transaction base make this a favourable risk-reward and arguably the best leasehold catalyst play in the batch.
